title: Junior Designer
note: Illustration-focused junior role turning Moomin characters into products for Fiskars' Nordic brands; apply in English with CV and portfolio.

facts.summary: Junior designer on the Vita Brands design team (Moomin Arabia, Iittala and other Nordic brands), reporting to the Creative Director in Keilaniemi, Espoo.
facts.duties: Make sketches, style guides, production-ready illustration files, mockups and patterns for licensed-character products; help with concepts, manage the design asset library, and prepare presentations and licensor approvals.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in illustration, graphic design, textile design or similar (or equivalent experience); strong Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; portfolio with illustration or character work. Interest in ceramics, glass or home goods helps.
facts.apply: Apply on Fiskars' Workday site with CV and portfolio in English by 29 Nov 2026; no cover letter needed.
